name: Bentleyville bank-robbery suspect (accused; silhouette only)
depiction: The man Pennsylvania police and prosecutors say robbed a Bentleyville bank on 15 March 2018 with a demand note written on a deposit slip and signed with his own name; ordered to stand trial in April 2018, outcome not found as of October 2026 (accused only).
